Maximum capacity (Emax) 25 t 45 t 90 t
Minimum dead load 90 kg
Accuracy Class C
Maximum number of load cell intervals (n) 6000 4000 4000
Ratio of minimum LC Verification interval
Y = Emax / vmin		 20000 11250 14000
Ratio of minimum dead load output return
Z = Emax / (2 * DR)		 6000 4000 4000
Temperature range -10 °C / +40 °C
Fraction pLC 0,8
Humidity Class CH
Safe overload 150 % of Emax
Recommended excitation 7,5 - 30 V DC
Excitation maximum 30 V DC
Transducer material Stainless steel
Atmospheric protection Hermetically welded
Number of counts for Emax 111111 for 25 t and 100000 for 22,5 t 100000
Software identification Version number: #A159401
